entities.name: Adair River Span
entities.description: Ancient oak treefolk monk of Lorwyn who fights with his fists and roams seeking to prove his prowess.

entities.name: Flann
entities.description: Ash sage and good friend of Adair, who has been killed.

entities.name: Honeystone River
entities.description: River Adair once drank dry on a bet.

events.summary: Adair drinks the entire Honeystone River dry on a bet.
events.quote: on a bet, he once drank the entire Honeystone River dry all on his own

events.summary: Adair seeks out his friend Flann, unaware she has been killed.
events.quote: unaware that she has been killed

relations.quote: Adair was a good friend of the ash sage Flann
